name: Tower Hamlets Cemetery Park Foraging
short_description: Monthly guided foraging tours in historic cemetery park.
description: A renowned foraging site managed by Friends of Tower Hamlets Cemetery Park. Monthly guided walks with expert Ken Greenway cover elderberries, blackberries, rosehips, hawthorn and more.
